summary: ADR-0050 accepted 2026-07-29; formal LKG recovery only via publish_knowledge_catalog.py --restore-lkg; recovery uses single-writer lock and validates LKG pointer, generation identity, artifact hashes, source snapshot, policy, query report, and current main; older LKG allowed only if ancestor and indexed inputs byte-match main; restores source snapshot, v2 Catalog, projections, v1 compatibility Catalog; post-restore publication checks, Locator gate, and canonical smoke required; stale LKG cannot supersede newer main; failed checks roll back and verify all four layers and pointers; publication activation is one rollback domain, current pointer written last; control scripts must byte-match pinned main; stale locks recoverable only for dead/reused owners or malformed locks after 60s, live/indeterminate owners conflict; pruning is independent via prune_knowledge_generations.py --prune; protects current, LKG, and five newest valid successful main generations; validity requires complete manifests/artifacts/layers/policy/source/query checks, never mtime; invalid or unrecognized generations are reported, not deleted; pruning requires intent and per-generation authorization with evidence; failure logs append-only and outside pruning; extends ADR-0048, complements ADR-0044, supersedes neither; retention policy knowledge/policies/generation-retention.v1.json
